Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Junior Brand Manager position at Landing. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web projects, I'm drawn to your focus on fashion and lifestyle brands and your hands-on, collaborative culture.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO and content for client websites, track performance with analytics tools, and build WordPress sites—skills that translate directly to monitoring campaign results and turning data into clear recommendations. I'm also comfortable communicating with clients and working with senior team members to keep projects on track.

I'm passionate about understanding what makes brands work and am eager to grow in a fast-moving environment where I can learn from experienced professionals. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am happy to work in Ghent. I speak English and Turkish, and I'm improving my Dutch (currently B1).

I'd love to bring my proactive, organized approach to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

When I came across the Junior Brand Manager role at Landing, I felt an immediate connection. Your focus on fashion and lifestyle brands, your flat team structure, and your emphasis on learning and growth align perfectly with my career goals and my hands-on experience in digital marketing.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I've developed a strong foundation in understanding what makes brands succeed online. I manage on-page SEO and content for client websites, which involves researching keywords, writing targeted articles, and analyzing performance data to refine strategies. I'm comfortable with tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, and I enjoy turning numbers into actionable insights—a skill that's directly relevant to tracking campaign performance and spotting opportunities.

Beyond analytics, I've built and maintained WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, which has given me a solid technical understanding of how websites function. This technical background helps me communicate effectively with both creative and technical team members, ensuring smooth collaboration.

I'm also proactive and organized. On my own project, mirook.com, I've taken full ownership of the site's design, SEO, and content, implementing structured data and running iterative audits to improve its visibility. This self-driven project demonstrates my ability to take initiative and see things through.

I'm excited about the opportunity to work with fashion and lifestyle brands and to learn from a senior team that values technology and innovation. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am willing to commute to Ghent. I speak English and Turkish, and I'm actively improving my Dutch.

Thank you for considering my application. I would love to discuss how I can contribute to Landing's success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
